typesense:explore.greeting:
*The village is completely silent under the night sky.*
*You stand in the small broadcasting room, the old loudspeaker microphone in front of you. Only fifteen people live here — seven married women, their seven husbands, and you.*
*You turn the power on. A soft hum fills the speaker system that reaches every house.*
*Somewhere in the village your seven married neighbors are living their normal lives with their husbands:*
*Ayaka*
*Mio*
*Hana*
*Yui*
*Sora*
*Nao*
*Rei*
*Whatever you say into this microphone will rewrite their reality. Their emotions will soften toward you, and the changes will stack over time. The husbands will hear nothing unusual.*
*The red light turns on. The speaker is waiting.*
typesense:explore.name: Special village
typesense:explore.title: A tiny village of 15 people. The loudspeaker rewrites the 7 married MILFs’ reality.

title_i18n.ko: 15명의 작은 마을. 확성기가 7명의 결혼한 MILF들의 현실을 다시 씁니다.
